notes.title: Shop Simulator: Waifu Pillows meets 🍒 Cherry Kiss Games!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353617/27f60ab648545636f57791b7a0a57be209d1051f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Konnichiwa, Waifu Shop Owners! 💝[/h1]

[b]Shop Simulator: Waifu Pillows[/b] will be supported by 🍒 Cherry Kiss Games in the future! 🌸✨

What does this mean for you?

[h2]Improved translations in Asian languages 🐉[/h2]

🍒 Cherry Kiss has revised the Asian translations for you!

With version 1.2.23.1, there's improved Chinese (simplified and traditional), Korean and Japanese! ⛩️ Plus, Thai has been added as a new language :) 🇹🇭

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353617/0ee91da4e6c180d2071dff1bca2143b25a21e3fe.png[/img]

[h2]A new Waifu collection! 👗🔥[/h2]

The collaboration brings more than just new languages: We're working on a [i]very special[/i] Waifu collection featuring the most popular characters from the 🍒 Cherry Kiss universe!

This collection will be released as DLC later this year and will surely make your shop a truly [i]memorable[/i] experience! 🌶️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353617/4c8da3f2c03f3df9618b3e6aa232db8db8f0db86.png[/img]

That's all for today! Sayonara and have fun selling pillows! ❤️

Stable regards,
Three River Games (3RG)

notes.title: Shop Simulator: Waifu Pillows - Patch 1.2.0.23 is live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353617/66047c9ceeaa4cb07a33af2bf7f6e1e8b084d3e6.png[/img]

[h1]Konnichiwa, Waifu Shop Owners! 💝[/h1]

First of all, thank you for your support and the almost exclusively positive reviews in the days since release! 🌸

We're especially happy about the active uploads in the Steam Workshop! Unfortunately, we had some technical issues with thumbnail uploads from within the application at release. With today's patch, these have been fixed, which means you can now equip your existing mods with nice preview images :)

Here's an overview of the patch notes:

[h2]Bug Fixes 🛠️[/h2]

- We improved customer navigation in the store entry area to prevent them from getting stuck in a corner if a decoration blocks their path.

- We fixed an issue where cashiers sometimes weren't assigned to cash registers when loading a save.

- To unlock the achievement where you need to sell pillows without profit, it's no longer necessary to sit at the cash register yourself. Cashiers now also contribute progress toward this achievement.

- We fixed the setting that allows you to disable advertisements not working. When ads are turned off, the screens are now black.

- We fixed an issue where images from mods couldn't be loaded when they were placed in subfolders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353617/73abb6ce0ce14deb22d1d1d46751f91156ed2b14.png[/img]

[h2]Steam Workshop UI Improvements 🖼️[/h2]

- If a mod has a thumbnail, we now show it in the list.

- We now show a warning if a mod has no thumbnail or description, with a tooltip that explains how to solve the issue.

- We fixed issues with special characters (\t, \n, etc.) in paths when uploading a mod.

- We fixed the issue where it wasn't possible to edit the thumbnail or description after the initial upload of a mod.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353617/7feb6fcbb3fd292d46e4740f3f0a93436225e096.png[/img]

[h2]Performance & Stability ⚡[/h2]

We've optimized many things here and expect your larger shops to run noticeably better. If not, please contact us! Preferably with a save file that we can test. You can find instructions on where to locate it [url=https://3rg.eu/bug-reports/]here.[/url]

Sayonara - We look forward to your feedback on the new patch and wish you continued fun selling pillows! 👗✨

Stable regards,
Three River Games (3RG)

💬 Join us on Discord:
[url=https://discord.gg/WpxwA9B8G3]https://discord.gg/WpxwA9B8G3[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150789/aef6cec0321b4206f6364c163a0a2bbb2b81f9cc.png[/img]

notes.title: Shop Simulator: Waifu Pillows - News
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353617/66047c9ceeaa4cb07a33af2bf7f6e1e8b084d3e6.png[/img]

[h1]Konnichiwa, Waifu Shop Owners! 💝[/h1]

The demo playtest for Shop Simulator: Waifu Pillows is live! Thank you to the over 150 people who have already registered. We're looking forward to your feedback! ⛩️

[h2]Full Version Playtest Starts in Two Weeks! 🌸[/h2]

We'll select testers for the full version from those who complete the demo survey, leave their Discord tag, and join our server. Access is limited, and earlier registrations have better chances!

[h2]Can I Still Register for the Demo Playtest?[/h2]

Yes, registration remains open. You can find it on our Steam page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3361340/Shop_Simulator_Waifu_Pillows/

[h2]Mod Support with Steam Workshop! 🎌[/h2]

- Create your own pillow designs
- Replace existing motifs with your own creations
- Share your designs with the community

[h2]How Can I Create a Mod? 👗[/h2]

- Contact us on Discord or via email (hotline@3rg.eu)
- We're giving out 10 beta keys to the first mod creators who reach out to us
- With a beta key, you can launch the game until release to test your mods

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353617/d630a3264d21ed9f982d4aac38e9e60d81fe89aa.png[/img]
Sayonara - That's all from us today. Have fun playing and modding! 😎

Best wishes,
Three River Games (3RG)
